{"script":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
# Save raw representation
if declare -p var >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  declare -p var > var_raw
else
  printf 'UNSET\n' > var_raw
fi

# Extract raw value if set
if declare -p var >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  raw_value=$(printf '%s' "${var}")
else
  raw_value=""
fi

# Metadata
len=$(printf '%s' "$raw_value" | wc -c | tr -d ' ')
sign_present=no
case "$raw_value" in
  [+-]*) sign_present=yes;;
  *) sign_present=no;;
esac
has_dot=$(printf '%s' "$raw_value" | grep -q '\.' && echo yes || echo no)
has_comma=$(printf '%s' "$raw_value" | grep -q ',' && echo yes || echo no)
contains_space=$(printf '%s' "$raw_value" | grep -q '[[:space:]]' && echo yes || echo no)

cat > var_meta <<EOF
length_bytes=$len
has_leading_sign=$sign_present
has_dot=$has_dot
has_comma=$has_comma
contains_space=$contains_space
raw_example='$raw_value'
EOF

# Normalize
norm="$raw_value"
# trim
norm=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
# extract leading sign
lead=""
if printf '%s' "$norm" | grep -q '^[+-]'; then
  lead=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | sed -E 's/^([+-]).*/\1/')
  norm=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | sed -E 's/^[+-]//')
fi
# handle separators
if printf '%s' "$norm" | grep -q '\.' && printf '%s' "$norm" | grep -q ','; then
  norm=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | tr -d ',')
else
  if printf '%s' "$norm" | grep -q ',' && ! printf '%s' "$norm" | grep -q '\.'; then
    norm=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | sed 's/,/./')
  else
    norm=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | tr -d ',[:space:]')
  fi
fi
# remove non-digit/non-dot
norm=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | sed 's/[^0-9.]//g')
# keep only first dot if any
if printf '%s' "$norm" | grep -q '\.'; then
  norm=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | sed 's/\./#/; s/\."""/"""/g' 2>/dev/null || true)
  # simpler: replace first dot with placeholder, remove remaining dots, restore
  norm=$(printf '%s' "$norm" | sed 's/\./#/; s/\./ /g; s/ //g; s/#/./')
fi
# Final normalized with sign
var_normalized="${lead}${norm}"
printf '%s\n' "$var_normalized" > var_normalized

# Checks
is_integer=false
is_non_integer=false
evidence=""
if [ -n "$var_normalized" ] && printf '%s' "$var_normalized" | grep -qE '^[+-]?[0-9]+$'; then
  is_integer=true
  evidence="matches integer regex"
else
  if [ -n "$var_normalized" ] && printf '%s' "$var_normalized" | grep -qE '^[+-]?[0-9]*\.[0-9]+$'; then
    is_non_integer=true
    evidence="matches decimal regex"
  fi
fi
if [ -z "$raw_value" ]; then
  evidence="empty or unset"
fi

cat > var_checks <<EOF
is_integer=$is_integer
is_non_integer=$is_non_integer
evidence=$evidence
raw='$raw_value'
normalized='$var_normalized'
EOF

# Summary
{
  echo "VAR_RAW:"; cat var_raw; echo; echo "VAR_META:"; cat var_meta; echo; echo "VAR_NORMALIZED:"; cat var_normalized; echo; echo "VAR_CHECKS:"; cat var_checks;
} > var_analysis_summary

# Final decision
if [ "$is_integer" = "true" ]; then
  echo "yes"
else
  echo "no"
fi
"}
